nom: BYOMA Brightening Serum for Dark Spots + Texture

avis.titre: Have only used a few days and need to see if it works over t
avis.texte: Nice texture and absorbs into skin well but too early to tell if it helps with dark spots. The jury's still out

avis.titre: Great on mature, dry, sensitive skin
avis.texte: I have been using this product for a little over a month, and I'm impressed. I've used Vit C sera before, but this one has delivered results quickly. My pores appear smaller and lighter, and my dark spots are slightly less visible. Overall, the texture of my skin has improved considerably in a short amount of time. My skin is fairly sensitive and dry, but I have not experienced any drying or irritation from this product.

This isnt an agressive treatment for darkspots. This is more of a steady girlfriend situation. The main ingredients here is Lactic Acid, Vitamin C and Niacinamide. When you think about… How much of these ingredients are you already using daily?

This stuff is one of the few products in my skincare journey that has really noticeably improved my skin. After I put it on my skin feels so moisturized and stays bright and shiny. I have acne prone skin too and it hasn't broken me out at all. Will definitely be repurchasing.

I literally Used it once and my skin was so shiny and it felt super moisturized. And it also was very affordable for only 17 dollars and it's 1 oz compared to glow recipe which is less then 1 oz for 36 dollars and shipping!!!!!

This has ceramides hyaluronic acid and niacinamide, so it has a lot of ingredients that are just in one! I do have to say sometimes it would set up on my face, but I think that was because of my cleanser because I also did that with my toner.

Yall it made my skin feel SO moisturized and I have like REALLY dry skin but then I started breaking OUT!!! I will get a pimple every FEW months like I am blessed with my skin but I BROKE OUT! Never happens to me. Everyone's skin is different though!!

I'm 47 w/combo dry w/oily t zone. I highly recommend this product for any skin type. It's very gentle and soothing. I use it as one step in my skincare routine- step 4 of 7. I 🤔 I was reordering this, but instead I ordered the Hydrating Serum. We are going on a new adventure!

Overview: For about 3 years, my favorite serum to use was the Good Molecules discoloration toner, but it was very slow acting. Since I I make slightly more money now, I wanted to try out a serum with similar actives to the one I previously used. I've had really good results on with, especially since the formulation offers mainstays in dark spot correction like niacinamide, while also having other ingredients to boost your skin's barrier like hyluronic acid. It feels like a serum that takes into account what actives work best for correction of dull skin/dark spots, while also knowing how to support those actives. Context on my environment: I live in an urban area with pollution. Air is often dry here and I have hard water in my tap. My skin is often dry and stripped after using any soap or cleanser. I find it difficult to produce enough sebum or collagen, so my skin is often dull. I have recently moved, so my skin is also not used to this environment, esaperating potentially underlying weaknesses on my skin. I am in my mid-20s and do not have hormonal imbalances, nor any skin condition. Application: I find it works best with collagen and sun protection as well, since it can make your skin sensitive to sun damage. In terms of texture, it absorbs fairly fast. I like to use it immediately after my mucin serum dries, since it absorbs very fast if your skin is dehydrated. Once it does dry, it does not leave a film and is odorless. It's a pretty safe serum to add to routines since t

I've only been using it a short while. The plus, no irritation, doesn't leave me oily and soaks in very well. I will continue to use it with hopes of seeing some change. No results yet! I like the price, I like the size and hopefully in a few weeks I'll like the product even more than I do now.
LOVE THIS SERUM!!! I use it in the mornings and it makes my skin look so gloomy and fresh. Does not make my face feel greasy or break out.
This is a great product. It's works better or about the same as the high end ones.

I've used this serum almost every day for the past several years, and it works great. I tend to only use it in the morning (I've had a pretty set nighttime routine for years), but after I used this for a few weeks I noticed my skin barrier was healing and my skin actually started looking like skin again. I'm 39 and I had gone years with horrible acne, scars, unevenness, and dark spots. This serum was one of the first things I changed in my routine that actually helped me. I don't notice any stickiness, no leftover residue, it dries down very fast, lays great under makeup, and I have never noticed any smell.
Love this serum. Gentle on skin and noticed a huge differnce with acne scars. Lasts me about 3-4months when I use it for daily/nighly routine.
Love this serum. Gentle on skin and noticed a huge differnce with acne scars. Lasts me about 3-4months when I use it for daily/nighly routine.

Tried this product for a day used it, and I noticed my face felt weird. Went to go wash my face and felt bumps all over and revealed so much redness under the makeup I was wearing and small white dots all over. I've never experienced something like this with the product before not sure what it was but maybe I'm allergic to it or maybe there was just a higher concentration of an ingredient. Hopefully, this goes away within a couple of days.
This is a really good serum! It's very hydrating, and gentle on my skin. I would recommend this product!
This serum is amazing! It work so well. I started seeing results in a week. My face was so much brighter and glowy! It didn't leave my face oily or dry in any way.
I've only been using this product for a week and I can tell a huge difference in my complexion!
Byoma is the current skin care I use and it's been so good to my skin. Will buy it again and again!
I have the normal skin type and i'm 20, but I'm not typically acne prone aside from menstrual cycle related breakouts, but this ended up breaking me out in places that i don't typically ever breakout
Amazing! So hydrating and not that expensive! I loved it, and it made my skin feel incredible.

I am obsessed with this serum because 1. It does work! After a week my face got brighter which I love!! 2. It felt so relaxing and nice on my skin in the morning and at night!!! 3. I don't know if this is true but personally it felt really hydrating on my skin and make it more clearer and took away some acne!! 3. It didn't have a huge smell which I really liked!! You should definitely buy this!!!!

I was hesitant to try another niacinamide serum after The Ordinary's 10% serum burned the heck outta my face, but I wanted to reap the benefits of niacinamide so I gave it a shot. Best decision EVER! I have extremely textured skin, and I can never go more than a day without washing my face before it gets so oily and textured and congested and YUCK! But using this paired with Paula's Choice salicylic acid cleanser, WOAH MOMMA my skin texture is GONE! I also had a very compromised skin barrier due to poor skincare practices in the past, and this has helped SO much in healing my skin! I recently attended a 5 day event and only ended up having time to wash my face ONCE in that 5 day period, but I was absolutely amazed that my skin still felt clean and texture-free despite HEAVILY sweating and skipping face wash two days in a row, I've NEVER been able to skip even one day without my skin getting all congested til now! I've noticed a SIGNIFICANT reduction in the amount of oil and sebum my skin produces (combination skin, a lot oilier in the summer!) and the hyralonic acid compliments my lightweight gel-cream moisturizer PERFECTLY! I am so extremely fungal acne prone in addition to having very sensative skin, which made finding a good serum a nightmare, so I'm so happy to have finally found a keeper!
i started using this serum about 3 weeks ago and my skin has gotten so soft and smooth. great product.

avis.titre: Don't walk RUN and get this product
avis.texte: I've been using this product for about 3 weeks and when I tell you I see a difference in my skin. My texture has got much better and some of my dark spots have faded. Also my face has been looking a lot more glowy. Also you get a lot of bang for your buck because you got 2 serums in one.

i have two serums and use this as my morning serum, and my face is always sticky afterwards, like i rubbed my skin onto a glue stick. my skin looks sooo clean afterwards, but i have to repeatedly wash my hands to get it off < /3

This Byoma brightening serum was great! It was soothing and cool on my skin. It made my skin bright and glowy. It had the consistency of water but smelled like a very dense and thick pancake syrup. Except for that, I recommend this product! The smell lasted for less than 30 minutes for me!
It instantly made my skin feel hydrated the first day i used it. If you have dry skin or dry to combo skin it doesn't make you oily but also doesn't leave your skin feeling tight.

avis.titre: I am about to buy this again
avis.texte: I LOVED this product so much. super hydrating. I use this as a daily product, and it last up to 3 months or more. I will be buying this again. for this good of a product so cheap and very a fordable. I got this for a birthday present and would take this any day for a present.

I like to mix it with like a thick moisturizer and it hydrates pretty good. I have pretty clear skin so i rarely notice a difference when i use products but i do feel like my discoloration is fading away same with my eye bags. I loveeee it
This product is literally like putting water on your skin. Save yourself the money.
switched from good molecules to this, night and day after a week. smaller pores, brighter skin. also easier on the thinner parts of my face like my eyes. definitely recommend!!

Just started using this and I'm a huge fan- I was using some very expensive skincare recommended by my aesthetician and it worked ok- but this stuff packs a punch at a fraction of the cost. I saw a massive difference in my melasma and uneven skin tone in just a week. I was using it twice a day.
I love this serum so much! Its super light weight and i dont have to use much. Its very fast acting too- i notice a difference the next day.
Omg works magic already repurchased so good also I hate lots of smells but this one didn't bother me
I rarely write reviews but the entire BYOMA line is incredible. I saw a significant change in my skin after on a few days. Would definitely recommend and I will continue to buy in the future.

avis.titre: A big no no for me.
avis.texte: Bought it because I wanted to lessen the amount of steps in my skin care routine as it has HA + Niacinamide. Didn't see much results within the first couple weeks, but thought it just needed some time to adapt to my skin. One day i noticed i had a lot of red dots on my face, which later evolved into a full blown break out. 😩 I've had clear skin for my whole life, maybe a pimples here and there… but 6 juicy pimples at once??? I countinued using the serum for a few more days, and more pimples surfaced. Since Byoma was the newest serum to my long time skincare routine, I stopped it. My skin has calmed down since then, but now I'm fighting acne scars. 😭 Im not saying this is a bad product, maybe just not for me or my skin type. For reference, my skin type is oily. (Confirmed my medspa)
I have been looking a brightneing serum and this one is well priced as well as feels so good on my face. A little goes a long way.

This serum changed my life! Not only is it gentle on the skin, it actually works! It has helped my skin barrier like no other. The price is amazaing and now part of my daily skincare routine. If you're someone with sensitive skin this is definitely worth trying.

It was my first time trying this brand product and I gotta say that I like the way it makes your skin feel it's not sticky or anything like others I know that are very sticky or the irritate are bothered because I have sensitive skin and you know what

I have combo mature skin thats fairly clear. I skin cycle to keep my skin hydrated living in the desert. I wanted to like this and it doesn't cause me any breakouts but all my othey hyaluronic acid or niacinamide serums really make my skin shine. My guess is that this serum also include lactic acid which is a conflicting ingredient. Will not continue using nor will I buy again.
My skin did break out but it has adjusted and makes my skin more glowy.
My absolute favorite products are their serums i love this brand

I have heard good things about Byoma, I've seen many videos on social media and reviews praising their skincare line. I'm a 19 year old girl who has always struggled with acne since I started puberty. Recently I started a birth control pill and had some hormonal breakouts (worse than the ones I experienced pre-pill) since I was adjusting to new hormones. This serum INSTANTLY made a difference from the day I started using it. I've noticed a significant decrease in my acne dark spots from scarring and past pimples. This being said, I've also used their Clarifying Serum and Hydrating Serum at the same time. I use all three everyday since the day I got them and they are GREAT. The Clarifying Serum helps with breakouts, the Brightening Serum has really helped lighten some dark spots from old cystic pimples, and the Hydrating Serum balances my skin without leaving any greasy residue. I 100% recommended these products, my skin is usually sensitive to certain ingredients but I have never had a reaction to these products. I don't think I have ever left a review before but these products were so helpful for me that I felt the need to.

I love this serum so much. Niacinamide, ceramides, and hyaluronic acid are so good on my skin, and prior to using this, I'd have to use different serums to get these ingredients. I love that it's a 3-in-1. I use this in the morning to plump and brighten my skin and it always gives me a nice glow. I definitely feel like my skin barrier has improved since using this serum.

I absolutely love this brand and especially this product. Ive used this for about 6 months and im obsessed. It feels so soothing and makes my makeup look beautiful everytime. My skin looks so bright and beautiful

Ok so I'm slowly but surely falling in love with this brand ! I'm a first time user of their products and I love the way they perform. This serum is amazing !! Definitely brightening but super gentle in my sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Good, but use maybe twice a day for more effect
avis.texte: I like this serum and I feel like it's faded some of my dark acne spots but not much of my hyperpigmentation. It's hydrating which is great for me, but I didn't see much of a difference until I started using it twice a day. I feel like this is good for people with more sensitive skin that want a lighter brightening serum.

I had some dry patches on my face that i could not get rid of, no matter how much i exfoliated and moisturized. I stopped using all other products, and only used this serum along with moisturizer for 2 weeks AM and PM. Dry patches gone, my skin is healthy again, barrier restored! Will keep using!

I haven't noticed any difference in brightness using this. I do love Byoma, so I am surprised at the lack of difference. Maybe I haven't been using it long enough or it just doesn't work for me. Either way I can't recommend. Gifted by Byoma

I love this brightening serum! It has such great ingredients and I've been using it very night for the past month and I've really seen a difference on my skin. My dark spots are brightening and my skin is feeling more hydrated. This was gifted by BYOMA.

This oil makes my skin so soft and supple. I love how it's fragrance free and doesn't irritate my skin and cause breakouts. Those pairs perfectly with the Byoma moisturizer and has transformed my skin. I was gifted by Byoma

I love this for the day time. I does well with my other skincare. Wears really well inder makeup. Gives hydration and the cerimides help me combat the dryness from my nightime retinol. I have oily skin and this doesnt make me extra oily but helps dry spots.

This really has been amazing for brightening and renewing my overall texture and tone. I feel like my sun spots are less noticeable and all over my face looks more radiant and clear, especially less dull! I was gifted by BYOMA and I can't recommend enough!

I have been loving this moisturizer! I have been using it everyday mostly in the morning as it's light and I can put makeup over it! Packaging is adorable and user friendly as well. This was gifted by BYOMA but opinions are all my own.
this gave me redness that won't leave, I had never had any before then but months later I still have it. don't buy this!! save you're skin pls 😭

I received complimentary from BYOMA their brightening serum and it has worked wonders for me. So in love with this brightening serum. It feels amazing on the skin and it gives my such a beautiful glow. It works well with other skincare products and my makeup products. My skin feels so soft and hydrated , love it! Complimentary from BYOMA.

This is one of the best serums I've ever tried! I love how it's affordable and how hydrated it leaves your skin! It layers super well with my other products! I can't recommend this hydrating serum enough! Gifted by byoma

Super pretty on my skin! Makes my skin soft and glowy. I haven't been using this long enough to see if it has made a significant impact on my acne scars, but I think I see a slight difference. Super cute packaging! Gifted by BYOMA

Although the bottle I'm reviewing I received complimentary from Byoma, I've actually already emptied an entire bottle of this before this review. I love this serum for during the day to make my skin look super bright, it's so lightweight that it layers nicely under moisturizer. Definitely a fantastic value for $$.

I'm obsessed with this product! It makes my skin feel so hydrated and looks so gooey after applying. I've been using the product for only a couple of days and already see a difference in my skin. (This product was gifted by byoma.)

Gifted by BYOMA This is a really nice serum! I'm loving the formula. The serum absorbs quickly and my skin looks brighter and has a nice glow. There is no scent and paired well with my combination skin.

This product is super hydrating and feels so amazing on my skin! It doesn't smell weird like other serums on the market do! I would recommend this to anyone with dry, uneven, dull skin! It is useful for fighting off dry uneven texture. Gifted by BYOMA

avis.titre: Easily became one of my Favorites!

I recently got an app that tells you about the ingredients in the products you use daily and this brightening serum is 100/100 and excellent because of the non-hazardous ingredient it has. It has easily become one of my favorites!

I was gifted by BYOMA and this brightening serum has allowed me to see results almost instantly which I don't find often with serums. I'm really excited to use it this summer so I can be extra glowy. Overall a really great product!

I am super impressed with this serum! It has Niacinmanide that helps brighten my skin, and Hyaluronic Acid that hydrates my skin. My skin feels so plump and hydrated after using this serum. I love it! gifted by Byoma

I love this product for my daily routine! It gives a pretty glow to your skin and leaves it moisture and hydrated! It's lightweight and love the ingredients that this have! I think it's perfect for teenagers gifted by BYOMA

I genuinely love how gentle this is on my skin! It is a new staple in my everyday routine because of how lightweight it feels yet it is so cleansing and I genuinely notice a difference in my skin! Gifted by BYOMA.

It's powerful brightening facial serum with Niacinamide man and hyaluronic acid. It's not only hydrates my skin, but also improves the texture . Gifted by BYOMA.

What a good serum! I've seen these all the time and have herd amazing things about the brand itself definitely so reachable to the consumer which I love when brands are accesible to us not being so crazy expensive gifted by BYOMA

avis.titre: Love this blend of the ingredients

My skin is bright and youthful after using this. I love how simple the packaging is. It's bright and colorful and the product inside is just as great. I highly recommend using this in your daily skincare routine. Gifted by byoma.

This BYOMA brightening serum made my skin feel a lot more hydrated and my skin looked much brighter. It is very light and absorbs into my skin well. In the time that I have been using this brightening serum, I can also see improvement in my skin texture as well.

I've been using this about 3 months and it's definitely made my skin look a little better. It feels pretty good after applying and dries quickly. I think it has evened my tone and made my skin look a little softer

I've been using this serum for a couple of weeks now. I love how light it is and it's been very hydrating. I also have noticed that some of my dark spots from acne have lightened so the product definitely works! I would recommend this.

I've been trying out different serums and like this one from Byoma. It doesn't leave the skin feeling oily or wet. It dries quickly and provides a nice, clean looking flow after a shower and face cleaning! I can absolutely see the difference in only a few days.

Been using for a little over 10 days and my skin is glowing and so soft!! Adding in this serum is the only change I made and the difference is remarkable! So glad Tik Tok recommended this!!

Tried this product for 3 weeks so far and ive noticed a difference. I usually apply the product after washing my face at night time. I then moisturize and apply spf. My dark scars are lighter and im sure they will be gone by the summer time.

The brightening serum has been a wonderful addition to my evening skincare routine. It is easy to apply and does not take much product to get the job done. It makes my face feel refreshed and leaves a glowing effect without being oily.
Love love love this stuff. Clean ingredients and does what it says. My face breaks out easily and this did not break me out. It's a win from me.

Really like this product, it's got cubic modern packing any easy to apply serum and great results. It's great to find a product that works well with my more sensitive abs oily skin. Highly recommend this for your daily skin routine.

This is a great addition to your morning routine. Just a drop or two and massage right in. It gives your face that extra glow and brings your face from dull to brightness. Convenient size bottle to add to purse

I had never heard of this brand prior to trying this brightening serum from them. But let me tell you, it's awesome! It applies smoothly and dries quickly. I can notice a different from my tone, especially around my cheek area and forehead. Has a good consistency when you apply it and doesn't leave you feeling sticky.
This made my skin beautiful, even my friends noticed a difference. It's also affordable. I love this brand. Will be repurchasing

I believe byoma brightness serum is a good serum. It's odorless and it's lightweight and gets absorbed into the skin very quickly, however it doesn't work on people with only skin because it break me out a lot so I don't know if it helps brighten the skin when I consistently keep breaking out so maybe it would work better on someone with dry skin.

It works amazingly! I love that it doesn't leave my skin greasy. My skin has never been brighter! I have gotten so many compliments and questions on what I've been using. I highly recommend adding this to your skin regimen.

I recently got Byoma Brightening Serum as sample and opinion is my own. I have been very pleased with it. The serum has a light, pleasant scent and it absorbs quickly into my skin. I have been using it for about a month and have already noticed a difference in my skin's tone and texture. My skin is brighter and more even-looking, and the fine lines on my forehead have begun to diminish. The serum also leaves my skin feeling soft and hydrated. I'm very happy with the results so far, and I would definitely recommend this product.

After washing my face I put on this brightening serum then apply sunscreen. The serum doesn't have any fragrance and absorbs very quickly. It leaves my face feeling fresh and clean and looking a little brighter.

I bought this product a few weeks ago and have been using it daily in the morning. I have noticed a change in my complexion my face looks brighter and clearer. I would highly recommend to all individuals.

So I wasn't sure I was going to like this product. To my surprise I see some difference in my skin it definitely is looking less dull and I've seen a change in my dark spots. I can't wait to see what happens after the year of using this product.

I use this everyday and I can definitely see a difference with this serum rather than my others! This serum leaves my face looking brighter and more clear, even after washing my face I still have a glowing look. The serum itself isn't sticky at all and it's very easy to apply. It's definitely a must have in my daily routine now!

Byoma brightening serum observes into the skin very fast without sticky or messy residue. It is very easy to spread all over the skin and feels comfortable without the tackiness. I would definitely recommend this product.

I love serums, especially brightening ones because my skin can be a bit dull. This has been a solid serum and the packaging is nice and sleek. I take one star off because I haven't seen a ton of brightening effects from daily use, but what I have seen is that my skin is a bit softer, less prone to breakouts and it preforms as good as my favorite primers. Maybe I need to use it for a longer period to see the brightening effects (have been using it for 1 month now)

This Byoma brightening serum is nice to use in the mornings before I apply moisturizer. It's a product you need to use consistently in order to see results. I think the results are subtle but worth it. My face looks and feels brighter after a month.

I really liked this Byoma Brightening Serum. It has niacinamide and hyaluronic acid which helps even skintone and keep skin hydrated. I use this after I cleanse my skin and before my moisturizer. I feel like my skin definitely looks brighter and more even.

I've added the Byoma brightening serum into my skincare routine and I'm so glad I did. This serum is lightweight and absorbs into the skin quickly. It is not greasy and did not leave my face feeling sticky. I have dull, lackluster skin that is an uneven tone with dark spots and hyperpigmentation. In the few weeks I've been using after washing my face and before moisturizer it has noticeablely brightened my overall complexion. My skin is also very hydrated thanks to this product. Love it!!

This serum is one of the best ones I have ever tried. It absorbed nicely into my skin and doesn't leave any residue which is very important to me. It has a light, fresh scent as well and really helps me to look my best.

This is my first time trying out this type of skin product on my face. I've been using it for about a month and I plan to buy the other products from this line. I love this stuff. It makes my skin feel brighter and smoother. It's got a nice light scent and it's perfect.

I've tried other products from Byoma and have loved them, so I have this brightening serum a chance. I love it, too! It's formula is gentle on skin and my skin feels good. It looks good, too. Hydrating and brightening! The packaging is really nice. High quality product!!

My face is so smooth and it lights up a room. It has helped brighten my dull spots and my face looks less tired now. This is a miracle worker on my face and I love how it feels as I put it on. Overall, the best brightener serum I have found.
